Actually, the legal instruction says "continue the pre-set daily schedule and not to accelerate or enlarge purchases because of the pending transaction." The rationale: the pre-set schedule was established before the MNPI (Rule 10b5-1 plan perhaps). Continuing a pre-existing schedule is generally permissible under 10b5-1 if it was set up before awareness of MNPI. Accelerating or enlarging would be trading on MNPI.

Wait, but there's a subtlety: the memo says announcement is Thursday. If the buyback continues Monday-Wednesday, the company is buying its own shares while aware of the pending acquisition.
